description: You volunteer at a local escape room business. Transform the messy hint notes at /home/ga/Documents/escape_room_hints_draft.txt into a professional, properly formatted hint progression document. Create a DOCX file at /home/ga/Documents/alchemist_hints_final.docx with: (1) header with title 'The Alchemist's Laboratory - Hint Progression System' and subtitle 'Game Master Reference Sheet', (2) six puzzle sections each with puzzle name (bold, 14pt), brief description, three progressive hints (labeled 'Hint 1:', 'Hint 2:', 'Hint 3:' in bold), and solution (labeled 'SOLUTION' in bold red text), (3) horizontal lines separating puzzle sections, and (4) footer with game master tips. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
